_schema.purpose: Function knowledge for the terse minority whose directory blurb was too thin to stand alone (e.g. Backlog | 'MCP Server', IQLand | 'iqlandaimcp', non-English blurbs). Each entry states what the product actually does, sourced from online research (WebSearch) or established vendor knowledge — never left blank or hedged as a guess. infer.py merges this: it sets the function statement, may override capabilities, and marks confidence DOCUMENTED with the recorded source.

source_values.researched: confirmed via WebSearch of the vendor's site / press / profiles
source_values.vendor_knowledge: resolved from established knowledge of the product (incl. non-English blurbs)

iqland_official.function: AI real-estate land-development platform: parcel data, construction-ready plans, dynamic KPI analysis, and a marketplace of land-development opportunities for developers, agents and investors.

telgani.function: Saudi car-rental marketplace: compare prices and book rental cars across KSA (daily/monthly/yearly) with ~1-hour delivery and airport pickup.

caretta.function: Realtime AI copilot for live sales calls: transcribes the call, takes notes, and surfaces answers and objection-handling from an organisational knowledge base built from docs, site and playbooks.

syntitan.function: AI-ready data platform (CUBIG): scores whether enterprise data is ready for AI, fixes what blocks it, freezes the result as a versioned release state, and ties every agent run back to the exact data behind it.

graffiticode.function: Platform of deterministic, domain-specific 'smart tools' (spreadsheet logic, geospatial, compliance, assessments) callable via MCP so an agent gets validated, structured results instead of best-effort guesses.

isometric.function: Agentic certification platform for the industrial economy: AI agents cross-check sensor, satellite, supply-chain and lab data to certify carbon-removal and environmental claims, flagging discrepancies for expert review.

vianexus_vast.function: Agent-ready financial-data marketplace (vAST): market prices, reference data, fundamentals, estimates, news and filings, with entitlement-aware access purpose-built for AI agents. A data feed, not a brokerage.

amass_connector.function: Life-science scientific-intelligence API: 500M+ documents across biomedical citations, research abstracts, patents, clinical trials and regulatory filings for literature intelligence and scientific Q&A.

figaro_immobilier.function: French real-estate listings portal (Le Figaro Immobilier): search properties for sale and rent — 'find your ideal property'.

contract_factory_soci_t_s_siren.function: Official French company information from the RNE (Registre National des Entreprises): firmographics and SIREN/SIRET registry lookups for French businesses.

juridata.function: Sourced Moroccan legal research (statutes and case law), built to scale across Africa.

backlog.function: Backlog (Nulab): project and issue tracking for software teams — tasks, boards, wikis and Git/SVN repositories.
